newsitem.title: UK: UK's OFT seeks to expose sports goods price fixing.
newsitem.headline: UK's OFT seeks to expose sports goods price fixing.

text.p: Britain's Office of Fair Trading launched a campaign on Tuesday to expose price fixing by suppliers of sports goods.
"We want to help small traders to stand up to powerful suppliers who are ignoring the law by trying to fix prices," John Bridgeman, director general of the OFT said in a statement.

The OFT said it wanted retailers who had been prevented from selling goods at a discount or below manufacturers' stated minimum prices to report on what it called unlawful resale price maintenance. The OFT said suppliers usually threatened to withhold supplies if retailers discounted prices.

Bridgeman said his office, which has placed advertisements in trade publications asking for evidence of price fixing, had received dozens of complaints. He said resale price maintenance seemed to be a particular problem in sports goods retailing.
